item.title: Fashion Komyushou-kun to Business Bocchi-chan
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: 3 on 10
  • 発売日: 2019-12-31
  • スコア: 5.93/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ファッションコミュ障くんとビジネスボッチちゃん
  • 英語名: Fashion Komyushou-kun to Business Bocchi-chan

别名

  • Fashion Commushou-kun to Business Bocchi-chan

あらすじ

Fashion Komyushou-kun just wants to make money.

He wants to work more hours and more shifts.

However, his current part-time job at a convenience store does not allow him to work more shifts.

At a loss, Fashion Komyushou-kun decides to quit his current part-time job at the convenience store in order to find another, more profitable one.

あらすじ

Average salaryman working at a not so average company.

It turns out they are playing dirty with money!

The protagonist gets sick of all the corruption and

using all his savings decides to go on a vacation!

When he ends up on the tropical island, looks like

they’ve used him as a scapegoat for their embezzlement!!
